children: The veteran journalist exits News18 India after nearly a decade, having held editorial and anchoring roles across Hindi news and current affairs
Veteran journalist and news anchor Amish Devgan steps down from News18 India after nearly a decade with Network18 and is set to join Times Network for his next television role.
Devgan makes his final appearance on News18 India with his prime-time show
, marking his departure from the channel. During his tenure, he takes on responsibilities spanning anchoring, editorial management and news operations.

Devgan joins Network18 in 2016 as Executive Editor and anchor of its Hindi news channel. During his tenure, he plays a key role in strengthening the channel’s Hindi news strategy and is associated with the launch and growth of
, through which he covers political, economic and current-affairs issues.

In 2019, Network18 appoints Devgan as Managing Editor for News18’s Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan operations, expanding his responsibilities beyond prime-time anchoring to include newsroom and editorial management.

Devgan begins his journalism career with Hindustan Times in 2002 before moving to television with Zee Media. He joins Zee Business in 2005 and spends around 13 years across various editorial and anchoring roles.

At Zee Business, he serves as Deputy Editor, Editor – Output and Editor – Special Projects before being appointed Chief Editor in May 2015. His work includes coverage of commodities and agriculture, including programmes such as
He later expands his coverage to business news and current-affairs programmes such as
, covering politics, the economy, financial markets and major national and international developments.

Devgan also works on reporting and investigative journalism, with his work covering subjects including the coal scam, the Odisha mining scam and investigations related to businessman Nitin Goyal, according to the report.

With a journalism career spanning around 24 years, Devgan receives several industry recognitions, including the International Television and Film Awards 2015, Srishti Award for Business Journalism and Power Brand Trendsetter Award 2016. He also receives the exchange4media News Broadcasting Awards (ENBA) during his Network18 tenure.
With his departure from News18 India, Devgan’s association with Network18 comes to an end. His move to Times Network marks the next phase of his television career.
